persona: Simulated first-time RILL user: a beginner songwriter making a simple melodic hip-hop sketch

findings.observation: Double-click for MIDI hint led directly to the instrument library and assigning Rill Lab Sine created a usable pattern.
Pencil note drawing was direct, note names were visible, and drawing past the initial clip end extended the pattern automatically.
My initial Duplicate drag did nothing; Tool help clarified that the tool copies on click. Subsequent click duplication was fast.

My Cut/Erase attempt near 30 seconds left the last whole copied drum region absent. I accepted the resulting two-bar melodic outro. Dragging the loop range endpoint did not visibly extend the loop, so I disabled Loop.
Rename project offered a mouse-operated on-screen keyboard; save and export dialogs inherited the project name and session location.
WAV export stated Arrangement 0:30, sample rate, stereo format, and effect tails clearly; MIDI export displayed an explicit success notice.

Playback repeatedly failed with Audio output stream failed or disconnected. Choosing the named laboratory output did not fix it. Error details specified a buffer underrun or overrun at 48000 Hz and 1024 frames. Following Stop then Play briefly advanced the playhead before the error returned.

rating_reasons.easy_to_use: Notes, instrument assignment, naming, saving and exports were discoverable. Duplication and trimming took trial and help, and playback could not be sustained.
rating_reasons.how_cool_it_looks: Clean dark layout with readable waveforms, teal track panels and visible note names feels appealing for a small sketch.
rating_reasons.how_fast_it_is: Drawing and repeated clip copies were responsive. Export took visible time, and playback troubleshooting slowed the session substantially. This is a subjective session rating, not a hardware benchmark.
rating_reasons.how_confusing_it_is: Duplicate's click behavior and the unsuccessful loop/trim gestures were unclear at first. Tool help and the explicit audio error details reduced the uncertainty.
rating_reasons.feature_completeness: The visible workflow covered audio, MIDI note editing, a real VST3 instrument, mixer controls, project save, WAV and MIDI export. Only this limited sketch workflow was assessed; reliable playback remained unresolved.

outcome.composition: Seven two-bar C-minor-oriented melodic phrases at 112 BPM through Rill Lab Sine. The final phrase resolves to C4. Supplied Circuit rhythm audio repeats through approximately 25.714 seconds, followed by a two-bar MIDI-only outro.
outcome.playback: Multiple failures; briefly advancing playhead after Stop/Play recovery, then output error again.

limitations: Simulated usability participant, not a human study.
Only visible mouse operations used; no keyboard events, shortcuts, source inspection, app-state APIs or composition-file editing.
No audio capture was auditioned, so no claim about audible quality, musical balance or successful sustained VST playback.
Project, rendered duration, PCM content and MIDI contents require independent verification; these were not inspected through filesystem APIs by this participant.
Laboratory software graphics and timer-paced virtual audio output are not representative of physical audio hardware. Only Rill Lab Sine VST3 was used.
